incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in fire, with flames visibly consuming the roof and interior, and smoke rising from the structure.

observations.description: Large, bright orange flames are visible consuming the roof and interior of the house.
Smoke is visible rising from the burning house, particularly near the roofline.
The roof is partially collapsed and burning, with visible charred sections.
A single-story house with siding and a porch is on fire.
A white window with a hexagonal frame is visible on the left side of the house.
